current.text: He is not among the projected Bucks starters. The backcourt is crowded with Herro, Rollins, Porter, Burries, Trent and Green.
He will probably be in the rotation, but Gary Trent Jr. could take that spot instead.
The Milwaukee rotation is very unclear. New coach Taylor Jenkins' rotations are hard to predict, and he might use a deep rotation.
He had good assist and steal numbers in Summer League. One expert stays skeptical because he has no clear role in Milwaukee.
Experts call him the deal breaker in the Giannis trade.
Milwaukee could use him as a trade chip, and he is valued like a first-round pick. The roster needs trades to consolidate.

durable.text: He is worth more in category leagues than in points leagues.

note: Yahoo ranks him 343 and ESPN ranks him 237. Both sites value him at 0 USD, so he is well outside the 144 players we draft. Do not bid on him. His projected line of about 8 points and 3.3 assists has no category outlier and is below the pool in points, rebounds, steals and blocks. In the first weeks, check whether he keeps a rotation spot ahead of Gary Trent Jr. and whether a trade moves him to a team where he has a clearer role.
